Capillary Rheometers
Product catalog summary
Technical Highlights
Available in single, twin, or triple barrel systems with sizes ranging from 9.55 mm to 30 mm.
Speed range from 0.00004 to 40 mm/s, with high dynamic acceleration of the test piston.
Temperature range up to 400°C, optionally 500°C, with a display resolution of 0.01°C.
Features "Plug & Test" pressure transducer connectivity and adaptive pressure signal resolution down to 0.005% of full range.
System Overview
The RHEOGRAPH series (20, 25, 75, 120) utilizes CAN-Bus technology, offering automation, user-friendliness, and a wide shear rate range. It includes an integrated color touchscreen and automatic pressure transducer detection.
Pressure Measurement Improvements
Enhanced accuracy with pressure measurement resolution improved by a factor of 10.
Repeatability improved by a factor of 10, expanding the measurement range by at least one decade.
Flow Instabilities and Thermal Conductivity
Detection of flow instabilities (Shark-Skin) using a measuring cell with high-frequency sensors.
Thermal conductivity measurement developed according to ASTM D5930, with a temperature range up to 450°C and pressure up to 1000 bar.
PVT Measurements
Conducted according to ISO 17744, determining pressure, volume, and temperature characteristics.
Features easy handling with a quick die locking system and automated sequence control.
Die Swell and Viscosity
Determination of dynamic and static die swell with high-resolution systems.
Pressure dependence of viscosity measured with a counter pressure chamber, optimizing flow processes in machinery.
Software and Evaluation
Network-capable software system for parameterization, measurement, and evaluation using Microsoft ACCESS Database.
Evaluation with WinRheo II includes various corrections and approximations for flow curves and elongation viscosity.
Performance Data
Force range from 20 kN to 120 kN, with various barrel geometries and temperature control features.
Device integrated PC with a color touchscreen and Microsoft Windows® database software "LabRheo".
Contact Information
